purpose: Teach: 不謹慎/憤慨/貫通/弱体/降下/命中/至難/浴びせ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、被災地での不謹慎な発言を批判した文献を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you addressed the criticism of a politician's insensitive remarks in a disaster zone in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Open, warm inquiry. Calm delivery with genuine curiosity. Slight lean-in at the name. Steady pace, inviting response.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、世論が憤慨した政治家の事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the incident involving a politician whose comments provoked public outrage.
lines.style: Direct, earnest response. Clear articulation of the research focus. Modest tone, no overstatement. Slight pause before the detail.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、弾丸が壁を貫通する物理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you also covered the physics of a bullet penetrating a wall in your work, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Reflective tone, gently probing. Warm but careful — not accusatory, genuinely exploring.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、独裁体制が弱体化する過程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the mechanisms of how authoritarian regimes weaken and destabilize.
lines.style: Steady, clear explanation. Earnest without defensiveness. Methodical in laying out the subject matter. Even pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 傘下に降下する空挺部隊を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: In your papers, you've examined airborne units conducting aerial drops under command, haven't you?
lines.style: Engaged, attentive follow-up. Warm tone with active interest. Light forward lean in posture. Encouraging without pushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、砲弾が命中する精度の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the accuracy and precision of artillery strike effectiveness.
lines.style: Direct statement of research scope. Earnest and unadorned. Calm delivery, matter-of-fact. No apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地形が至難の山岳戦を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You've also taken on the challenges of mountain warfare in difficult terrain as a subject in your papers, haven't you?
lines.style: Reflective, measured pace. Thoughtful intonation. Genuine interest without pressure. Slight warmth underneath the careful framing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、罵声を浴びせる暴動の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the historical patterns of civil unrest and mass protest movements.
lines.style: Final, closing statement. Earnest tone with a sense of completion. Clear and direct. Slight softening at the end, acceptance of the conversation's natural endpoint.
